title: Student
summary: I would like to use my experiences and knowledge to make an impact on someone's life. Having someone to guide you through times and someone who you can rely on is very important and it would be a pleasure for me to be that for someone.
support_summary: I can help my mentee by being there for them, listening to them and guiding them through their journey in life. I can specifically help high school students prepare for college and college admissions, and also how to be successful in high school itself.
experience_summary: I am a freshman at the University of Texas at Austin, but my journey to get here was anything but easy. I constantly moved homes throughout my life, however the toughest move was probably moving to the US from India during my freshman year of high school. This exposed me to a lot of challenges figuring out the school system and adapting to the new culture. I also went to an academically competitive school so I learned how to deal with those pressures. Additionally, I was a varsity athlete (tennis) all four years, so I also learned how to balance that with my schoolwork.

title: Founder/CEO
summary: I've been through such a winding path with seemingly unrelated pivots and, despite career anxiety along the way, found contentedness and sustainability. I want to help others explore their unique strengths and apply those to their chosen career...without stress along the way.  We all deserve to have an impact on this world.
support_summary: I can help find your strengths and show you how you can use them.  In addition, I can provide tools and resources for strengthening your skills. Also, I can help you find a community in which you can test out your learnings and enjoy support.
experience_summary: Hi there! It's such a pleasure to meet you. A bit about me...I grew up in Toronto and then in, what seemed like the other side of the world, San Antonio, TX.  I trained at the National Ballet of Canada and the Boston Ballet, before touring with such artists as L.L. Cool J, Shaggy and Biz Markie. After obtaining a degree in History and French from the University of Pennsylvania and a J.D. from Osgoode Hall Law School, I indulged my love of sets and passion for designing environments with a degree in Interior Design from Whitehouse School of Design in Sydney, Australia. After working at McKinsey & Company in New York, I launched GrasshoppHer, to challenge the traditional silos of mentorship and provide better access to a community of mentors. I hope that GrasshoppHer will disrupt the status quo and enable girls and women alike to achieve more, together.

title: Personal Trainer and Health Coach
summary: I very much enjoy the mentoring process, especially when a concept really clicks with the individual or they experience clarity on an issue that has been troubling them. I would like to become a mentor for GrasshoppHers to help women bring regular, enjoyable exercise into their life, follow dietary habits that leave them feeling good and to help them to feel strong and accomplished through strength training.
support_summary: I can help my mentee to better define their health and fitness goals, develop an exercise routine that suits their goals and lifestyle, teach them how to perform certain exercises (barbell and dumbbell-based, mostly) that they're unfamiliar with, create an exercise program for them to follow (we can spend 1x60 minute session writing a 4-6 week program), alter their body composition (often times this doesn't involve hard-dieting) and create an overall health-focused program that incorporates strength training and sustainable nutritional habits that is in line with their goals and will leave them feeling good.
experience_summary:
As a teenager, I had an extremely unhealthy relationship with food and with my body. I would look at myself in the mirror, pinching and pulling at the parts of myself that I didn't like and subsequently restrict my food choices and portion sizes. Fast-forward 10 years, I am now a personal trainer, health coach and powerlifter. I have competed at the Australian National Championships in Powerlifting and find a lot of joy and fulfillment within the sport. One of my greatest memories in the sport is when I deadlifted 170kg (374lb) for the first time.

I like the term 'health coach' because my coaching centers around helping individuals to feel good and able within their own skin, not running them into the ground with copious amounts of exercise and limited food. I want to help you to feel STRONG and CONFIDENT, however, that may look to you.

title: Life & Business Coach
summary: I'm on a mission to help more women multiply their income and impact without multiplying the hustle.
support_summary: I have 10+ years of experience as a Fortune 500 strategist turned certified life and business coach. I provide strategy and mindset advisory to coaches and consultants design, launch, and scale a signature offer to 6-figures and beyond. It's all about making marketing, sales, and client delivery simple. And I walk my clients step-by-step through each part of this process.
experience_summary: I’m a Fortune 500 strategist turned certified life and business coach. I help coaches, consultants, and experts like you create 6-figures+ with one scalable, signature offer. If you want to multiply your income and impact without multiplying your hustle, my accelerator program is for you.

title: Social Media and Operations Supervisor
summary: I have gotten a lot from hearing other people's testimonies so I feel as though mine might be able to help someone else out.
support_summary: I can provide direction as far as networking and getting to where you want to go. I can also provide tangible skills and tasks for you to test your strengths.
experience_summary: Hey y'all, I am Hannah Roper. As a fellow human, I've had many path changes and in those, I have found that I can share my story and help others find their own trail. Need help climbing to the top? Let's take a hike together!

title: Visual Artist/Art Director
summary: I want to help people have a somewhat easy transition into the field or give them guidance, motivation, etc. I understand first hand blindly finding my way through the creative industry and having to learn some very challenging (and at the time seemingly unnecessary) pivotal lessons lol. I also think it's extremely important to pass information around. Gatekeeping is a very real thing and I've realized that it does much more harm than it does good.
support_summary: I can help my mentee by giving them the tools (advice, guidance, etc) they need in order to make decisions that benefit them and if I ever come to a point where my help has reached a stopping point or they need more than I can provide, I can point them in the right direction to someone who can.
experience_summary: Hey, My name is Nyasia Sylvester and I'm an artist in all senses of the word. A little unconventional, versatile, sensitive and ever-changing. I'm a visual creator that specializes in photography but I dabble in a little bit of everything from painting, writing, cataloging & Art directing just to name a few. For 7 years I stumbled around trying to find my footing as a photographer, essentially find my voice and through my journey, I've found that and much more. At 28 I've found my SELF and a sense of purpose.

title: Social Media Intern
summary: I love being a mentor to enhance the lives of others. I want to inspire people and offer a different perspective. Plus, an extra helping hand never hurts.
support_summary: I can help my mentee by exhibiting modes of confidence, instilling productive ways to be successful, and sharing my own experiences along the way.
experience_summary: My experience with competing on different dance teams, graduating from an all-girls high school, and joining my university's sorority life has molded me into a self-driven, ambitious, and confident student, worker, advocate, and leader. I am a strong woman both within and outside of the classroom, and I aim to empower the surrounding community. My employment history consists of the restaurant and retail industries, but I am pursuing an Advertising & PR major because of my passion for creativity and problem solving.

title: Director
summary: Lesley Robinson is passionate about empowering students - especially women - to find the best path to their own destination and absolutely believes in ‘taking the world by the horns.’
support_summary: By bringing a mix of experience in higher education, nonprofit management, and corporate partnerships, with a proven record of supporting students and early-stage entrepreneurs to have innovative experiences with impact embedded.
experience_summary: Inaugural Director for the newly launched Kendra Scott Women’s Entrepreneurial Leadership Institute at The University of Texas at Austin. The KS WEL Institute supports a curricular and co-curricular effort to provide students with promising college-to-career pathways, especially women and creatives underrepresented in entrepreneurial roles.

title: Product Development Project Specialist
summary: After I graduated, I had been mentored by several women who continuously inspired me with their work and guided me to find a suitable job. These women supported me through resume reviews, navigating through the networking process, preparing me for interviews and this eventually enabled me to secure 4 job offers from big pharma/biotech companies. Now, I want to give back to the womxn community and help individuals going through a similar process of job search. I want to encourage them to have faith in themselves, and to direct them towards appropriate resources (just as so many women helped me), to help them find a job that makes them happy. I want to also encourage women to not settle for anything they get but aim for bigger goals.
support_summary: I can help my mentee through the resume review process, strategies for effective networking, conducting informational interviews, targeted job search, resume reviews and interview preparation.
experience_summary: Experienced professional with technical and business acumen and passionate about building products that solve healthcare problems. She is currently working at Medtronic as part of the PMO group, managing the interdependencies among projects, products, and other important strategic initiatives across the organization. Previously, she worked with Otomagnetics, a pharmaceutical startup, where she focused on product and project management and is knowledgeable about product lifecycle management, market research and business development. Isha also has prior strategy consulting experience working with Bain & Co, where her work focused on North America & EMEA- to support strategic, operational and financial analysis for Life Science clients. She is recognized for her strong communication skills, analytical thinking, leadership and organizational skills.

title: Growth Strategist Lead

support_summary: I will help by sharing my experience ( highs and lows), help them build a plan to accomplish their dreams and create a strategy that will help them overcome any obstacle that might stand in the way.
experience_summary: I have over 10 years of experience creating brand awareness strategies for startups. In my spare time, I help young women discover their potential and plan for the future.

title: Founder/CEO
summary: I want to support people to be the best version of themselves. Every individual is different and brings value in a different way but we can always learn from each other on our journey.
support_summary: Bounce off Ideas, Provide recommendations, Provide Connections, Review Resume.
experience_summary: A scientist by discipline, a mom and a purposeful career woman. Grew up in Nigeria, West Africa and have been a product of mentoring for a long time. However, in the workplace, I didn't have a lot of mentors like me and find it easy to get mentors.
